notes.title: Update 1.2.0.1
notes.notes: Fixed Chinese Simplified localization not showing

notes.title: Automate It – Update 1.2.0.0
notes.notes:
Performance Improvements
Upgraded the core engine, delivering +20% performance on all machines.
Levels & Achievements Adjustments
Levels are no longer Weekly → they are now Fortnightly.

Achievements for former Weekly levels have been reduced to 15 points.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.2
notes.notes:
Added a new rule that includes solutions using alternative recipes in World 1 as Pro Ranking
 Updated FSR version


Important Note:

The rankings and galleries of World 1 had to be updated due to a discrepancy regarding whether alternative recipes should or should not be considered for the Pro Ranking in that world. Because of this, the rankings for stages W1_L4, W1_L8, W1_L9, and W1_L10 were changed. If you notice any inconsistency after this update (for example, if you previously had both a normal record and a Pro Ranking record), please replay the stages to resave your rankings.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.1
notes.notes:
Added DLSS 4
 Building space is now showed on the building tooltip
 Level builder now checks for buildings outside the building areas to avoid upload of impossible levels

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.0
notes.notes:
Added interface dark mode,

Added option to disable auto screenshot when the level is completed,

Now copy and edit key shortcuts will copy/edit the selected building if pressed when a building is selected,

Added option on splitter to disable the rate limit based on the preview,

Now is possible to rotate receivers on level editor,

Stars and best metrics of a solution are now shown in the tooltip,

Fixed pipes disconnecting when copying a solution slot,

Added option to disable weather

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.0.11
notes.notes: Fixed duplicated solution at Weekly not working properly.

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.0.10
notes.notes: Weekly Challenges now count up to 10 Stars. Fixed records for everybody that already complete past  Weeklys.

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.0.9
notes.notes:
Duplicate Stars in Rankings Fixed:
Fixed an issue where players were receiving duplicate stars in both normal and pro rankings. The system now correctly identifies the best result per player without duplications.
 
 Ranking Ties Handled Properly:
Players with identical performance (time, energy, and space) now share the same rank position. This ensures fairer and more accurate leaderboard placement in the case of ties.

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.0.8
notes.notes:
Fixed being possible to place machines mid air,
 Fixed liquid/gas objective not completing on No Constraints mode
 Gallery is now blurry by default to not show solutions
 Fixed World 2 Level 7 time star
 Fixed Autosave description

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.0.7
notes.notes:
Fixed incorrect text sizes in some languages,
 Fixed splitter not releasing the full rate of input in certain cases,
 Fixed 0.05s time difference that should not occur, this was noticed in the level 7 of world 1 (lowest time is the correct one so there won't be a best time that could only be achievable on old version),
 Added option to not show any future unlockable buildings and mechanics in previous levels.

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.0.6
notes.notes:
Fixed graphics settings (shadows quality) being reset,
 Fixed texts being at wrong size after changing UI scale,
 Adjusted some ambient sounds and sound effects

notes.title: 🚀 Get Ready! Everything You Need to Know Before the Release!
notes.notes:
🏭 The machines are humming, the puzzles are tuned, and the final version is almost here!

Automate It releases on May 27, 2025 
(4 PM CET / 7 AM PT)

🛠️ We’ve seen your comments, your wishlist adds, your excitement, and we’re incredibly grateful for it!

So here it is ⚙️ Automate It: Factory Puzzle will launch at $14.99, with a 10% discount during the first two weeks as a thank you for your support 🛠️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2472770/Automate_It_Factory_Puzzle

📌Regional prices (the discount applies to these too):

 GBP – £12.79
 EUR – €14.79
 PLN – 49.99 zł
 RUB – 399 ₽
 JPY – ¥2000
 CNY – ¥54
🧰 These are just a few examples to give you a sense of the pricing. If you're in a different region, Steam will display the correct local price when the game goes live.

🎵 Official soundtrack coming at launch!

It features 28 tracks composed by Pablo García Lozano, taken directly from the immersive in-game music. Each piece blends subtle harmonies with energetic themes to capture the atmosphere of Automate It, and you’ll be able to enjoy it anytime, even outside the game!

⚙️The demo will be taken down on May 22
Your feedback during the demo and playtests helped us fine-tune the game in ways we couldn’t have done alone. It's hard to overstate how valuable your input has been throughout development. And now that the full version is ready, we can’t wait to welcome you into the complete experience! 🎮

💙 Thanks for all your support and feedback so far. We’re almost there!

Get ready to build smarter, optimize harder, and think inside the box 🤖
Automation awaits!

notes.title: Automate It Demo Gets a Big Update 🏭
notes.notes:
We're excited to share that Automate It Demo is all set for Steam Next Fest! Whether you’ve tried it before or it’s your first time, this is your chance to dive into our world of automation and see what the game is all about.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636210/Automate_It_Demo/

The new patch 0.9.7.3 brings in alot of changes:

📖 New Features & Improvements

Tutorials Overhaul – Tutorials have been completely redesigned for a better onboarding experience.
Demo Levels Reworked – The demo levels have been refined and improved.

🌍 Localization

Brazilian Portuguese  – The game now supports Brazilian Portuguese!
Simplified Chinese  – The game now supports Simplified Chinese.

🛠️ UI & Visual Fixes

UI Enhancements – Various visual fixes and UI improvements.
Machine Connection Indicators – Improved connection visuals for better readability.

🏗️  Gameplay Adjustments

Elevator Rework – The elevator no longer has an advanced mode; it now only features the Invert Mode, activated with T.

⚡ Performance & Bug Fixes

Loading Time Optimization – Improved transition load times for a smoother experience.
Bug Report Confirmation – The bug report system now properly confirms submissions.
